en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town in a valley with a river running through the center. There are rows of early-20th‑century houses with steep gabled roofs, a stone bridge crossing the river in the foreground, and a long railway or road bridge further upstream. The background shows patchwork agricultural fields and rolling hills with a winding country road. The image has the framing, aspect ratio, and border wear typical of an old photographic postcard. No visible printed caption or other text appears on the image side.
